svg.title: Constellation coverage map: four GNSS constellations over one day
svg.desc: Satellites in view over the whole Earth for one day, from a real run of constellation-design (constellation-multi-gnss-coverage.toml, engine run by this generator): 102 satellites (GPS 24, Galileo 24, BeiDou 30, GLONASS 24). Each 10-degree cell is shaded by the mean number of satellites above the 10-degree mask (27.2 to 36.5); the dots are the engine's ground-track samples, one per hour per satellite. Global availability 100.00 % at PDOP at or below 6, median PDOP 0.95, mean 31.0 and minimum 22 satellites in view.
